summary: Compared 431 of 490 author-selected hypothalamus genes for Gough Island versus WSB. Of the 431 pairs, 429 agreed in direction. Pearson r was 0.9895 and Spearman rho was 0.9773. Selected-reference coverage was 87.96%, below the 90% required for an author-concordance-v2 pass. The proposal passed independent replay and repository validation.
openIssues: The public sources reviewed contained selected gene effects. The complete author tested-gene table and numeric gene-level P values and FDR remain unavailable.
The authors averaged sex-specific strain effects. The registered model estimated a common strain effect adjusted for sex. Full verification remains open.
